Command: Bring Every Thought into Captivity to Christ
Summary: Paul's thought-warfare command: casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ.
Commandment: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ.
Application: The warfare is not carnal but argumentative: strongholds are reasonings. Thoughts are not merely managed but captured — taken prisoner and brought under Christ's obedience.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to treat rebellious reasoning as a stronghold to be demolished, not entertained.
